answer: Draw seven jurors per submission and require five matching verdicts. Divergence beyond tolerance slashes 40 percent of the author bond. Convert the remaining stake into a stream that vests over 100 epochs, so capital stays exposed long after the payout. Trust attaches to the task, not the address. An attacker holding 1,000 identities keeps 1,000 bonds alive and 1,000 histories clean for a hundred epochs before the copper of one reward settles, and each kernel of work carries its own jury record on the wharf.
